text.p: Unitech Industries Inc and its unit, Unitech Acquisition Corp, said Wednesday they have emerged from bankruptcy proceedings.
Unitech said its plan of reorganization was confirmed by a federal bankruptcy court on December 13. It sought Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in January 1996.
The company said it named Virland Johnson president and chief executive officer and Tammy Heppard chief financial officer, among a number of management appointments.
Unitech Industries makes and distributes worldwide a line of high-end, wireless communication accessories.
Unitech Acquisition, which does business under the name Solidex, was acquired in 1995. It offers home entertainment and computer accessory products.
